name: PI Cordless Bakhoor Burner
description: Traditional bakhoor, reimagined for modern life. A rechargeable electronic incense burner with a warm glow and an ornate bronze-tone lid. No charcoal and no cable, so you can carry the fragrance from the majlis to the bedroom, the office or the car.

name: PI Cordless Car Vacuum
description: Sand, dust and crumbs gone in minutes. A powerful handheld vacuum with a digital display and a full set of nozzles and brushes to reach every corner of your car, desk or home.

specs.Includes: Multiple nozzles and brushes, USB charging cable
specs.Colours: Black, Silver Blue, Silver Red, Silver Purple

name: PI Portable Tyre Inflator
description: Pocket-sized air power for every trip. Check and top up your pressure on the digital display. Ideal for re-inflating after the dunes, topping up before a road trip, or pumping up bikes and balls.

specs.Display: Digital pressure gauge (PSI, BAR, KPA, kg/cm²)
specs.Functions: Inflation, tyre pressure monitor, light, warning light

name: PI Car Aroma Diffuser
description: Your signature scent on every drive. A sleek aroma diffuser that sits in your cup holder and releases a fine, long-lasting mist from its faceted crystal-style tank. Also at home on your desk or bedside.

name: PI Cordless Heated Lunch Box
description: A battery-powered lunch box that warms your food anywhere — at the office, in the car or on a picnic. No socket needed, with a digital display and timer.

name: PI Portable Rechargeable Blender
description: Fresh smoothies, shakes and baby food wherever you are. A slim, cordless blender with a carry strap that fits in your bag, car cup holder or gym locker.

specs.Features: Low noise, easy to clean, carry strap

name: PI Cordless Bladeless Fan with Ambient Light
description: A quiet, rechargeable bladeless fan with a soft ambient night light. No blades to clean, no cable needed — move it from desk to bedside to car.

name: PI Bladeless Neck Fan
description: Hands-free cooling for Qatar summers. Wear it around your neck on the walk to the car, in a queue or at an outdoor event. Bladeless, so it never catches your hair.

specs.In the box: Neck fan, charging cable, user manual

name: PI Rechargeable Outdoor Fan with LED Light Ring
description: A tough, cordless fan with a built-in LED light ring and a huge 20,000 mAh battery. Built for camping, the beach, the car or power cuts at home, with a carry handle to take it anywhere.

name: PI Rechargeable Tripod Camping Light
description: Light up the whole camp, no generator needed. A tall, foldable tripod light with bright LED panels, three colour temperatures and a remote control, so you can set the mood from your chair.

name: PI Portable Baby Bottle Warmer
description: Warm milk to the perfect temperature anywhere — in the car, at the mall or on a trip. A rechargeable, cordless bottle with a digital temperature display, ready whenever your baby is.

name: PI Triple Laptop Screen Extender
description: Two fold-out screens that clip onto your laptop and turn it into a three-screen workstation. Plugs in with USB-C and folds flat to take anywhere.
